subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub accept publisher follows as a first-class API-token HTTP surface now, or pause this base slice until the broader follow/feed stack is reviewed together?
rationale: The implementation is a new product/API boundary over private user preference state, and automation cannot decide whether this is the right contract to expose before the dependent UI and notification stack lands.

options.title: Accept the base API after proof
options.body: Require runtime follow/list/unfollow proof plus docs and generated artifact fixes, then review this PR as the base follow-graph API slice.

options.title: Review the stack together
options.body: Pause this PR until the controls, notifications, and feed-route drafts can be reviewed as one product/API sequence.

options.title: Decline first-class follows
options.body: Close or narrow the PR if maintainers do not want publisher follows exposed as a ClawHub HTTP API surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the base API after proof
recommendation.body: Require runtime follow/list/unfollow proof plus docs and generated artifact fixes, then review this PR as the base follow-graph API slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The route/schema API baseline history makes this the best available owner for the public API contract question.
